Chapter 771: Chapter 2 The Confusion of the Nine Supreme Beings (Please Subscribe)

“There’s no need to worry or fear; they just want to see you,” said the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being softly.

In the Two-dimensional World, Lin Yuan swept through the Different Species in all directions, overwhelming and crushing special beings such as the Four Divine Kings and other Level Eleven Perfect Legendary Lives, shocking even the Supreme Beings.

Thus, aside from Xia Qin Supreme Being, the other Supreme Beings were also alerted and developed a strong curiosity about Lin Yuan.

“Alright,”

Lin Yuan nodded.

This was a good opportunity to deliver the eleven strange items.

...

These eleven strange items were treasures that people like Xuanyuan Dua and other human civilization Evolvers had obtained through more than ten thousand years of immense hardship and even deadly battles with Powerhouses of Myriad Tribes; Lin Yuan taking fifty percent was already more than enough, and he naturally would not embezzle.

For Lin Yuan, acquiring these strange items was incredibly effortless, a testament to his absolute strength.

For human civilization and other Eleventh-Rank Evolvers, acquiring these strange items, especially in the later stages, was only possible through competition with Powerhouses of Myriad Tribes, a difficulty that is imaginable.

“Stand behind me.”

After looking at Lin Yuan, the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being initiated changes in the surrounding space-time.

“I can feel the distance between me and my true self stretching to countless light-years in an instant…” Lin Yuan’s heart was turbulent, recognizing that the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being in front of him was not the true body.

But rather an insignificant incarnation.

Very soon,

Lin Yuan followed the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being to a grand palace.

“This is the number three stronghold of our human civilization,”

Feather Butterfly Supreme Being stopped and explained with a smile.

The number three stronghold was where the nine Supreme Beings usually met.

After the creation of the Virtual World by human civilization, the number three stronghold was seldom used, as the Supreme Beings mostly gathered in the Virtual World, which was more convenient and simple.

“Mm.”

Lin Yuan nodded solemnly.

This palace exerted a great pressure on him, it was at least a Supreme Weapon, and a very powerful one at that.

Among the more than a hundred strange items obtained in the Two-dimensional World, none could surpass this palace in terms of oppressive force.

Following behind the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, Lin Yuan entered the palace.

Deep inside the palace,

nine enormous thrones were occupied by nine majestic figures.

Upon arrival, the form of Feather Butterfly Supreme Being quickly dissipated.

“Greetings to the nine Supreme Beings,” Lin Yuan immediately bowed to show his respect.

Lin Yuan held great respect for the Supreme Beings in his heart because, for the Supreme Beings, protecting human civilization was completely altruistic.

In the Battlefields of Different Races, human civilization’s Sixth Rank, Ninth Rank, Tenth Rank, and Eleventh-Rank Evolvers fight fiercely with the Different Species, which although is deemed as ‘duty’, also allows them to gain substantial benefits and rewards.

The Merit Points system devised by human civilization rewards those who contribute with many benefits and privileges.

This has led to the dazzling state of human civilization today.

A balance between input and output.

But what about the Supreme Beings?

They protect human civilization, devoting a great deal of time and energy; what do they gain from it?

Essentially nothing.

“Such formidable physical strength,” one of the Supreme Beings, the Ancient Power Supreme Being, stared at Lin Yuan and murmured.

As the ultimate existence in the path of strength evolution, the Ancient Power Supreme Being’s greatest asset was physical strength, adhering to the belief that strength breaks all laws.

Upon hearing this, Lin Yuan listened obediently.

His physical body naturally far surpassed that of other Tenth Rank Evolvers.

The path of Martial Tao was skilled in physical body strength, and with the enhancement from the Mysterious Gourd, his physical strength was twenty-three times that of the baseline.

Additionally, cultivating the “Body of Xuanhuang” significantly increased physical strength, as well as enduring the infusion from the Chaos Void Origin upon breaking through to the Tenth Rank…

Under the influence of many factors, Lin Yuan’s physical body had reached an inconceivably powerful level, relying solely on physical strength, he could probably challenge an ordinary Eleventh-Rank Evolver.

This was only the physical body of Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit; his true body was even stronger.

“Physical strength is insignificant compared to the comprehension of rules,” another Supreme Being on a distant throne, the Void God Supreme Being, slowly said.

“Hmm?” The Ancient Power Supreme Being glanced at the Void God Supreme Being.

The Void God Supreme Being, who mastered the Space Great Tao, was definitely one of the trickiest among the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization because it was impossible to locate his true body.

“Without a physical body, how can there be any comprehension of rules?” another Supreme Being spoke up, showing a kind smile to Lin Yuan.

“Lin Yuan,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said from his throne, “We are very pleased with your performance in the Two-dimensional World.”

“Thank you, Supreme Being,” Lin Yuan immediately replied.

To satisfy one or two Supreme Beings was already very difficult, but to satisfy all nine? At least since the beginning of the Starry Sea Era, it had never happened.

“Supreme Beings, here are the eleven strange items.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred slightly, and eleven strange objects appeared in front of him.

Among these eleven objects, eight were Twelve-Star Strange Material ingredients and three were Supreme weapons, two of which were attack-type and one was defense-type.

“They’re all fairly decent.”

The nine Supreme Beings seated on the throne glanced at them and nodded slightly.

To them, these strange objects were not very effective, but they could at least enhance the foundation of human civilization.

Moreover, since Xuanyuan Dua and other Tier 11 Evolvers had perished within the Two-dimensional World, these were items they sought for him. Though their usefulness was not as great as Lin Yuan’s, they still served to somewhat compensate for what was lacking.

“Lin Yuan, if you have any strange objects that you don’t need, you can exchange them for Merit Points at any time and then trade them in the treasury of human civilization for Twelve-Star Strange Treasures that can be of help to you,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being reminded him.

This time in the Two-dimensional World, only Lin Yuan had successfully made it out alive. Considering the size of the haul, it was definitely the largest for Lin Yuan.

With Lin Yuan’s strength that swept through the Two-dimensional World, he definitely obtained a batch of strange objects, in addition to the eleven distributed to him; Xia Qin Supreme Being estimated that Lin Yuan had probably more than thirty strange objects in his possession.

Xia Qin Supreme Being wasn’t interested in the strange objects Lin Yuan held, as they were obtained through his own strength and skill, but not all the strange objects were useful to him.

The Human Civilization’s treasury also recorded a batch of Twelve-Star Strange treasure weapons, with a rich variety, which could only be exchanged with Merit Points.

Lin Yuan could completely choose those suitable for himself.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Among the nearly a hundred strange objects obtained from the Two-dimensional World, most were not useful to him; instead of keeping them, it was better to exchange them for treasures and rarities that could benefit him.

After all, human civilization would not let him suffer a loss.

“I will take these eleven strange objects, then.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being waved his hand, and the eleven strange objects before Lin Yuan disappeared.

“I have asked you to come here because we plan to join hands and take you to the ‘banks’ of the River of Time once more, to improve your understanding of the Rule of Time and deepen your understanding of the fusion of time and space, striving for you to comprehend the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule sooner.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being continued to speak.

Lin Yuan had long penetrated the Rule of Time, but like the Space Rules, what is called a thorough understanding of the Rule of Time, was only understanding one aspect of the Rule of Time.

To finally comprehend the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, he still needed to continuously contemplate the Rule of Time.

With Xia Qin Supreme Being’s power alone, Lin Yuan could be liberated from the River of Time for dozens of breaths; if the power of the nine Supreme Beings were pooled, the time away from the River of Time would naturally be even longer.

Such assistance would be significantly more substantial towards Lin Yuan’s meditation on the Rule of Time.

Of course, when the nine Supreme Beings join forces to forcibly liberate a life from the River of Time, there will definitely be a backlash from the River of Time and the entire universe.

But considering the significant contributions Lin Yuan made in the Two-dimensional World, even though they had already distributed the eleven strange objects, Xia Qin Supreme Being and other Supreme Beings felt they should compensate Lin Yuan further.

As for the backlash, as long as the timing was well-managed and considering Lin Yuan was just a Tenth Rank Life, they could bear the cost.

“Head to the banks of the River of Time?” Lin Yuan’s expression showed slight hesitation.

Being at the banks of the River of Time, overseeing the entire River of Time, is an unprecedented great fortune for most lives.

But for Lin Yuan? He had already reached a pinnacle in his comprehension of the Rule of Time; even if he were on the banks of the River of Time again, it wouldn’t be very beneficial; after all, as a Tenth Rank Life, how far could he see in a brief visit to the ‘banks’?

From an efficiency perspective, it was far less beneficial compared to absorbing the orb containing the comprehension of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule by the powerhouses of Myriad Tribes.

The most critical issue was… Xia Qin Supreme Being likely underestimated the difficulty of taking Lin Yuan out of the River of Time again.

Similar to resurrecting past deceased lives, the stronger the life resurrected, the greater the backlash cost borne by the Supreme Beings.

Resurrecting a Sixth Rank Life compared to an Eleventh-Rank Life, the costs are naturally different.

And fishing different levels of life out of the River of Time to bring them to the banks also varies.

Within the River of Time, countless lives, based on the height of their own nature, show different body weights.

Undoubtedly, the higher the essence of life, the heavier the body weight; Tenth Rank lives in the River of Time are considered small fishes, while Eleventh-Rank lives qualify as big fish.

As for Lin Yuan? Even before falling into the Two-dimensional World, he had already matched the strength of an Eleventh-Rank Life, qualifying as a big fish.

Now, having experienced the trip to the Two-dimensional World and comprehended the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, with his inner world transformed, even in the River of Time, he would be considered a massive entity.

Occupying a tenth to a fifth of the riverbed, he belonged to the strongest level just under those Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Lives.

Xia Qin Supreme Being thought Lin Yuan was only a Tenth Rank Life, at most close to an Eleventh-Rank Life, so he assuredly believed he could easily take Lin Yuan to the ‘banks’ of the River of Time again.

However, the actual truth was probably different from what Xia Qin Supreme Being imagined.

“What is it?” Xia Qin Supreme Being noticed Lin Yuan’s hesitation, his eyebrows slightly raised.

“Supreme Being, could I perhaps change my reward?” Lin Yuan pondered for a while before speaking.

“Change the reward?” Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan, his expression slightly puzzled.

What reward could be more important than observing the River of Time?

What reward could be more crucial than taking a further step towards comprehending the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule?

“Actually, I have already comprehended the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment and decided to be honest, otherwise, he didn’t know how to refuse Xia Qin Supreme Being’s ‘enthusiastic’ offer.

“You have comprehended the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being fell silent, glancing at the other eight Supreme Beings around him, his eyes showing a hint of confusion.
